about: Explicitly historical catalog statements in docs/coverage/*.md and the newest ADR (coverage-docs-drift.test.mjs). An entry covers the listed non-current statements on lines of `file` that contain `contains`. A statement that claims to be current must never be listed here: fix the document instead.

Same dated ADR-087 addendum: format 6 / catalog 7 was the format introduced on 31.10.2026.
Dated ADR-106 addendum (05.11.2026): the format it introduced; the current format is stated in the ADR-107 paragraph above it.
List of historical formats that migrate strictly, and the previous 143 IDs whose order is preserved.
